name: Overturn Internal Revenue Service rule: Interim Guidance Simplifying Application of the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax to Partnerships
official: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Internal Revenue Service relating to "Interim Guidance Simplifying Application of the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax to Partnerships".
